name: PT Rohartindo Nusantara Luas Tbk
summary: Established in 2014 and headquartered in Tangerang, Indonesia, PT Rohartindo Nusantara Luas Tbk specializes in the online retail of an extensive range of engineering and household tools. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses specialized equipment for safety, electrical work, lighting, measurement, spraying, cutting, welding, drilling, and packaging. The company also supplies tools for AC systems, automotive and hydraulic applications, wind energy, hygiene, grinding, and gas systems, in addition to a variety of hand tools and chains. These products are offered through popular brands, including Nankai, Dongsing, Junior, Doobie Leopards, Tile Tools, GS, Rubystar, and American Eagle.
